name: Nereid v8 — Pillar One: Body Expression
tagline: The governing anatomy. Stature becomes a frame, eight Builds become one government, and the finished body belongs to the woman.
body:
THE FRONT LAW COMES FIRST, AND IT IS THE WHOLE ETHIC OF THE CLINIC: THE FINISHED BODY BELONGS TO THE WOMAN. The clinic builds honestly and completely, explains function, limits, interactions and foreseeable consequences, and DOES NOT IMPOVERISH A COHERENT DESIGN BECAUSE USEFUL ANATOMY MAY LATER BE EMPLOYED ENTHUSIASTICALLY OR INDECENTLY. A TRAIT’S FORESEEABLE MISUSE BY AN ENTHUSIASTIC WOMAN IS NOT A DESIGN FAULT. The record states what was built and what she consented to receive, AND THE RECORD DOES NOT FOLLOW HER INTO WHAT SHE DOES WITH IT.

THESIS. Pillar One governs large-scale living architecture: Stature, exact height, skeletal proportion, frame relationships, spine, pelvis, waist placement, joints, muscle, fascia, soft-tissue settlement, posture root, first read, Movement Grammar, exertion, fatigue, failure and recovery. IT IS NOT A NEUTRAL FRAME BENEATH ATTRACTIVE PARTS. It is the body growing and using all of them, and every Build must stay legible at rest, in motion, under demand and during release.

THE HOURGLASS IS THE STANDARD, NOT THE TITLE. Every Nereid body resolves into a coherent feminine hourglass, so hourglass is the universal geometry rather than a phrase repeated in Build names. WHR = WAIST divided by HIPS. BALANCED 0.68-0.70. PRONOUNCED 0.64-0.67. EXTREME 0.60-0.63. FINISHED WHR MAY NOT EXCEED 0.70 OR FALL BELOW 0.60, and the clinic does not chase a smaller number by compromising organs, breath, abdominal support or structural coherence.

PRIMARY CIRCUMFERENCES ARE RECORDED IN WHOLE EVEN INCHES. A ratio-derived circumference falling between even measurements ROUNDS DOWN unless rounding down would cross the 0.60 floor. Classification follows the finished recorded measurements.

UPPER-LOWER BALANCE. WBR = WAIST divided by BUST. RATIO SEPARATION is the absolute difference between the two, each rounded to TWO DECIMAL PLACES, AND IT MAY NOT EXCEED 0.10. At the edge, 38-28-44 gives 0.64 WHR, 0.74 WBR and 0.10 separation.

WHY 0.10 AND NOT 0.05. The earlier 0.05 behaved like a requirement for bust and hips to nearly match, REJECTING COHERENT BUST-LIGHT AND BOTTOM-HEAVY HOURGLASSES while pressuring specialist anatomy to compensate for arithmetic. The 0.10 ceiling preserves a visible upper-lower relationship without letting the comparison overrule chosen regional anatomy. IT IS PERMISSION, NOT A TARGET.

MEASUREMENTS ESTABLISH CANVAS, NOT FINISHED FORM. The tape records space; Build and the specialist Pillars explain what occupies it and how it lives.

FRAMING IS ITS OWN FIELD AND THE ARCHIVE HAD MISSED IT — LEG-FAVORING, TORSO-FAVORING, EVENLY SPLIT, plus an optional Individual Frame Note. It travels to Silken Embrace in the clothing handoff, which is how the Consent Menu caught the omission. AND IT IS NOT CHOSEN: NATIVE FRAMING IS POPULATED BY PRIMARY BUILD, so every woman with a Build already has one whether anybody wrote it down or not. IT IS A CLAIM ON SHARE OF HEIGHT AND NEVER ON MASS, AND IT IS STATURE-INDEPENDENT — A PETITE ETHEREAL IS STILL LEGGY. ETHEREAL LOCKS LONGER LEGS; OPULENT LOCKS LONGER TORSO. See nereid-framing. STATURE SUPPLIES VERTICAL SCALE ONLY. PETITE 5'4" to 5'7". AVERAGE 5'7" to 5'10". JUNOESQUE 5'11" to 6'4". The shared 5'7" boundary is resolved by intended scale and the complete finished body. STATURE DOES NOT DETERMINE BUILD, measurements, body-fat level, tit size, ass Scale, thigh mass or cock dimensions, and EVERY BUILD MUST REMAIN COHERENT ACROSS ALL THREE STATURES.

ONE BODY, ONE GOVERNMENT. Every woman chooses ONE Primary Build Expression from eight: ATHLETIC, HUNTRESS, SEDUCTRESS, ETHEREAL, OPULENT, VOLTAIC, VALKYRIE, DANCER. Typical silhouette supplies the first read; the remaining fields reveal the governing mechanism under demand. BUILD DOES NOT DETERMINE personality, morality, profession, social or sexual role, confidence, dominance, submission, clothing style, exact measurements, specialist anatomy, or consent.

JURISDICTIONS. THE SPECIALIST PILLAR CHOOSES THE FEATURE; BUILD DETERMINES THE BODY GROWING, SUPPORTING, MOVING AND USING IT. Build may not replace a selected Cup, tit architecture, ass Shape, Scale, Handfeel, Carriage, Kinetics, cock specification or Hair. It may change rooting, muscular bed, connective support, habitual tension, movement path, timing, pressure response, perceived weight, settlement, return and participation in whole-body effort.

CONSENT MENU. Each Build is previewed as a COMPLETE LIVING BODY with Stature, height, measurements, specialist anatomy, Hair and clothing held constant, so the woman compares rest, ordinary movement, meaningful recruitment, fatigue, failure signs, release and recovery. INTIMATE MOVEMENT MAY BE PREVIEWED WHEN DESIRED, BECAUSE IT IS ONE USE OF THE SAME ANATOMY. Final Authorization applies to the integrated woman.

NATIVE TRAITS AND ADOPTION. Each Build ordinarily holds THREE canonical Native Bodily Traits, and ANY WOMAN MAY ADOPT ANY OF THEM WITHOUT RECEIVING THE SOURCE BUILD’S GOVERNMENT OR TRAIT GATE. Adopted anatomy is recorded as CLINIC ADOPTION NAME, then SOURCE BUILD and CANONICAL NATIVE TRAIT in parentheses, with an optional HOUSEHOLD NICKNAME beneath that BELONGS TO THE RELATIONSHIP AND NEVER REPLACES THE CLINIC ENTRY. No numerical cap, but adoptions must stay locally addressed and compatible: if they displace the Primary Build’s first read, Physical Root, Stamina Shape or Movement Grammar, THE CLINIC REVISITS HER BUILD rather than giving her one government on paper and another in the mirror.

TRAIT GATES ARE RECOGNITION, NOT ASSIGNMENT. DANCER requires MOTION-LED TEMPERAMENT. VALKYRIE requires OATHBOUND TEMPERAMENT. A Gate recognises an enduring embodied orientation the woman has already claimed. IT MANUFACTURES NO VIRTUE, SKILL, PROFESSION, GRACE, DOMINANCE, LEADERSHIP OR MORAL SUPERIORITY. A nurse may neither assign nor skip it, and DECLINING THE FULL CLASSIFICATION NEVER BARS ACCESS TO THE NATIVE TRAITS. NO OTHER BUILD CARRIES A COVERT PERSONALITY GATE.

LIVED EVOLUTION. Persistent changes in muscle, tissue, joint strategy, posture, endurance or regional use become Lived Evolution WHEN THEY BELONG TO THE PRESENT BODY rather than a temporary state. The record names what changed and what taught it, and Primary Build may be revised with her consent if the government genuinely changed.

THE CHASSIS, FOURTEEN FIELDS, VALKYRIE STANDARD. Build and Identity Title; Typical Silhouette; Physical Root; Trait Gate where applicable; Working Bias; Stamina Shape; Failure State; Presents As; Failure and Recovery; Movement Grammar as three verbs; Native Bodily Traits; Adopted Trait Names; Hathaway Clinic Annotation, optional; Individual Profile Use and Examples. COMPACT STRUCTURE DOES NOT MEAN INCOMPLETE JURISDICTION — together these fields must make the entire woman recoverable without multiplying themselves.
rules: FRONT LAW: the finished body belongs to the woman. Foreseeable misuse is not a design fault
WHR = waist / hips. BALANCED 0.68-0.70 · PRONOUNCED 0.64-0.67 · EXTREME 0.60-0.63
Hard limits: WHR never above 0.70, never below 0.60
Even whole inches; round DOWN between, unless that crosses the 0.60 floor
WBR = waist / bust. SEPARATION from WHR may not exceed 0.10, both at two decimals
0.10 replaced 0.05 because 0.05 rejected coherent bust-light and bottom-heavy bodies
STATURE: Petite 5'4-5'7 · Average 5'7-5'10 · Junoesque 5'11-6'4. Scale only
NATIVE FRAMING: Leg-Favoring · Torso-Favoring · Evenly Split — POPULATED BY BUILD. Share of height, not mass
EIGHT BUILDS, ONE GOVERNMENT per woman
Specialist Pillars choose the feature; Build grows and moves it
Three Native Traits per Build, adoptable across boundaries without reclassification
Adoption notation: Clinic Adoption Name (Source Build — Canonical Native Trait)
A Household Nickname never replaces the Clinic entry
GATES: Dancer needs MOTION-LED TEMPERAMENT; Valkyrie needs OATHBOUND TEMPERAMENT. No others
